# Design & UX Standards — Clinic Network Booking

## Global budgets

| Category | Budget | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Accessibility | Every Client-facing surface meets WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard-only completion of every primary journey. | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Availability | Client-facing surfaces are reachable 99.5% of each calendar month. | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Localization | Single locale at launch; all Client-facing copy is externalised from the first release. | canvas: Localization |
| Scale | The product carries 200 Specialists and 10,000 Appointments per month at launch volumes. | Olena, 2026-07-09 |

## UX conventions

| Convention | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Destructive acts | A cancellation is confirmed in one explicit step that names what is being cancelled. | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Time rendering | Times are rendered in the Specialist's published timezone, with the timezone named. | call 2026-07-14 |
